lyrics.ti:
[[chorus]]
ከም ብዝሒ ሳህልኻ ኣምላኽ መሓረና/2/
ከምቲ ምሕረትካ’ውን ይቕሬታ ሃበና/2/
[[/chorus]]

[[highlight]]ኣንጽሃና ጐይታ ካብ እከይ በደልና/2/[[/highlight]]
[[highlight]]ነዛ ጸልማት ዓለም ከይከውን ዕድልና/2/[[/highlight]]

[[highlight]]ንሕናስ ፈለጥናዮ ኣበሳ በደልና/2/[[/highlight]]
[[highlight]]ፍጹም ኣንጽሃና ምሕረት ግበረልና/2/[[/highlight]]

[[highlight]]ኣምላኽ ኣሕዘናካ እከይ’ውን ገበርና/2/[[/highlight]]
[[highlight]]ይቕረ ክትብለና ቅድሜኻ ወደቕና/2/[[/highlight]]

[[highlight]]ቅድሜኻ ወዲቕና ክንልምን ነዓኻ/2/[[/highlight]]
[[highlight]]ጐይታ መሓረና ምውዳቕና ርኢኻ/2[[/highlight]]
lyrics.ti_ro:
[[chorus]]
Kem bizhi sahlikha ʾamlakh meharena/2/
Kemti mihretka’win yiqhreta habena/2/
[[/chorus]]

[[highlight]]ʾAntsihana goyta kab ʾikey bedelna/2/[[/highlight]]
[[highlight]]Neza tselmat ʿalem keykewn ʿidlina/2/[[/highlight]]

[[highlight]]Nihnas felet'nayo ʾabesa bedelna/2/[[/highlight]]
[[highlight]]Fitsum ʾantsihana mihret giberelna/2/[[/highlight]]

[[highlight]]ʾAmlakh ʾahzenaka ʾikey’win geberna/2/[[/highlight]]
[[highlight]]Yiqhre kitbilena qidmekha wedeqhna/2/[[/highlight]]

[[highlight]]Qidmekha wediqhna kinlimn neʿakha/2/[[/highlight]]
[[highlight]]Goyta meharena miwdaqhna riʾikha/2[[/highlight]]
